evidence.reason: The drain phases are parsed with an independent `--seed` option and both `drain-alive` and `drain-ambiguous` dispatch to the same `drain_refuse_phase(args)` without checking that the seed matches the phase name. Unlike the matrix-boundary guard at lines 2887-2889, there is no equivalent guard here, so `drain-alive --seed ambiguous` can run the ambiguous probe while the run is treated as the drain-alive phase. Bind the seed to the phase or reject the conflict as usage error before dispatch.
